definition: [ דֹּ֫בֶר ] noun [masculine] pasture (compare Aramaic דַּבְרָא , Syriac ) — suffix כְּעֵדֶר בְּתוֺךְ הַדָּֽבְרוֺ as a flock in the midst of its pasture Mic 2:12 (article with suffix, compare Ges «GKC:127»§ 127 , 4 b, who attaches ו as conjunction to following word); וְרָעזּ כְבָשִׂים כְּדֳבְרָם and lambs shall feed as (in) their pasture Isa 5:17 .
